data: What is the approximate value of the highest red line at 10^4 training pairs in the rightmost plot?

The question asks for the approximate value of the highest red line at 10^4 training pairs in the rightmost plot. From the caption, we know that the red line represents De→En, and the blue line represents En→De. In the rightmost plot (b), the red line is the higher one. At 10^4 training pairs, the red line appears to be around 25 BLEU. Therefore, the approximate value of the highest red line at 10^4 training pairs is 25.
